correctness.rationale: For k>=3, ell>=1, the k-1 nonattachment clique vertices X are pairwise true twins: leaving two white creates an unbreakable obstruction. With zero X omissions the clique supplies path propagation; with one omission and attachment initially blue, another clique vertex forces it. With one omitted X vertex and a white attachment, the clique is frozen until the path drives a force into the attachment. This happens iff the initial path blue set has its far endpoint or some adjacent blue pair; otherwise every path blue vertex is blocked. These mutually exclusive cases yield x^(k-1)(1+x)^(ell+1)+(k-1)x^(k-1)(1+x)^ell+(k-1)x^(k-2)((1+x)^ell-I_(ell-1)(x)), I an independence polynomial for P_(ell-1). The minimum coefficient gives Z=k-1 and exactly 2k-1 minimum sets. Independently exhaustively checked 24 parameter pairs k=3..6, ell=1..6, including ell=1 boundary; universal result rests on case proof.
